aiMetadata.description: Logs a new event to a LogSnag project channel (LogSnag is an event/activity tracking service). Use it to record that something happened — e.g. a signup, payment, or job completion — for monitoring or notification feeds. Requires the project name, channel, and an event title; an optional description adds detail. Not idempotent: each call appends a new event entry, so repeating the same input creates duplicate log entries.
